name: Sakata Noelle
source:
A shy girl who finds it hard to make friends, [spoiler] owing to how badly she was bulllied in her previous school. She often suffers from paranoia, and frequently has terrible nightmares.
 [/spoiler]
She is a perfectionist who pushes herself to her limits. Her sense of humor is rather strange, and she deliberately misunderstands Atcchan for the sake of nonsensical comedy.
